if [ ! -f "/data/warpgate.yaml" ]; then
  echo "Initializing Warpgate..."
  warpgate unattended-setup --data-path /data --http-port 8888 --ssh-port 2222 --mysql-port 33306 --postgres-port 55432
else
  echo "Warpgate already initialized, starting normally..."
  warpgate run
fi
Welcome to Mailu, your new email service. Please change your password and update your profile.

# Skip chown on mounted volumes, only run on /app
echo "Starting Mydia (skipping chown on mounted volumes)..."
mkdir -p /config /data /media 2>/dev/null || true
chown -R 1000:1000 /app 2>/dev/null || true
if [ -n "$TZ" ] && [ -f "/usr/share/zoneinfo/$TZ" ]; then
  ln -sf "/usr/share/zoneinfo/$TZ" /etc/localtime
fi
exec /app/bin/mydia start
